# PostgreSQL client library (libpq), optional. With it the servers can use db_backend: postgresql;
# without it they are built with the embedded SQLite engine only.
#   -DWITH_POSTGRESQL=AUTO (default) use libpq if found, ON require it, OFF never use it.
set( WITH_POSTGRESQL "AUTO" CACHE STRING "Build PostgreSQL support (AUTO, ON, OFF)" )
set_property( CACHE WITH_POSTGRESQL PROPERTY STRINGS AUTO ON OFF )
unset( HAVE_POSTGRESQL CACHE )
if( NOT WITH_POSTGRESQL STREQUAL "OFF" )
	find_package( PostgreSQL QUIET COMPONENTS Client )
	if( NOT PostgreSQL_FOUND )
		# FindPostgreSQL wants the server headers too on some versions; libpq alone is enough here.
		find_path( PostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIR libpq-fe.h PATH_SUFFIXES postgresql pgsql )
		find_library( PostgreSQL_LIBRARY NAMES pq libpq )
		if( PostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIR AND PostgreSQL_LIBRARY )
			set( PostgreSQL_FOUND TRUE )
			set( PostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIRS ${PostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIR} )
			set( PostgreSQL_LIBRARIES ${PostgreSQL_LIBRARY} )
		endif()
	endif()
	if( PostgreSQL_FOUND )
		message( STATUS "Found PostgreSQL client: ${PostgreSQL_LIBRARIES}" )
		set( HAVE_POSTGRESQL ON CACHE INTERNAL "" )
		set( POSTGRESQL_INCLUDE_DIRS ${PostgreSQL_INCLUDE_DIRS} CACHE INTERNAL "" )
		set( POSTGRESQL_LIBRARIES ${PostgreSQL_LIBRARIES} CACHE INTERNAL "" )
	elseif( WITH_POSTGRESQL STREQUAL "ON" )
		message( FATAL_ERROR "WITH_POSTGRESQL=ON but libpq (PostgreSQL client) was not found" )
	else()
		message( STATUS "PostgreSQL client not found: building with SQLite only" )
	endif()
endif()
if( NOT HAVE_POSTGRESQL )
	set( POSTGRESQL_INCLUDE_DIRS "" CACHE INTERNAL "" )
	set( POSTGRESQL_LIBRARIES "" CACHE INTERNAL "" )
endif()
